card.name: Slash inside DOIs and web addresses
card.fires_on: The slash (or the first piece after it) that follows the publisher number in a DOI, such as 10.1007 or 10.1186. Also the slash after a domain name in a web address.

modes.label: DOI slash
modes.description: The slash after the numeric DOI prefix in a reference citation.

modes.label: URL path start
modes.description: The slash or first path piece after a website domain.

card.plain: It fires at the point in a citation link or web address where the number or domain ends and the rest of the code begins.
